comic_mechanisms.mechanism: The person gets what they asked for, then a new fact reverses their desire.
comic_mechanisms.game_requirement: Establish their original intention clearly; let the player discover the changed fact before or after committing.
comic_mechanisms.performance_proposal: One silent reaction beat before the second request. This is proposed direction, not observed timing.
comic_mechanisms.cringe_failure: An NPC announces the joke or a caption explains why it is hilarious.

comic_mechanisms.mechanism: A tiny ordinary problem takes priority inside a supposedly grand situation.
comic_mechanisms.game_requirement: Give the mother call an independent timer and earlier relationship context.
comic_mechanisms.performance_proposal: Student drops the public bravado when the phone vibrates; officer remains occupied with an unrelated task.
comic_mechanisms.cringe_failure: Everyone speaks in fluent one-liners; the mother exists only to shout a stereotype.

comic_mechanisms.mechanism: Ask a straight logistical question where others expect confrontation.
comic_mechanisms.game_requirement: The question can be sincere, cheeky or mistimed depending on local conditions; it cannot guarantee immunity.
comic_mechanisms.performance_proposal: Deliver as a practical request, not a pre-announced roast. The other person can ignore it, answer literally or laugh.
comic_mechanisms.cringe_failure: A water-cannon joke automatically awards harmless-aura points despite distress nearby.

comic_mechanisms.mechanism: An edit presents a messy experience as effortless confidence.
comic_mechanisms.game_requirement: Show an unflattering raw moment before the triumphant cut; allow the player to approve, contextualise or refuse the edit.
comic_mechanisms.performance_proposal: Music begins half a beat too early, stops at the awkward interruption, resumes only when the friends react.
comic_mechanisms.cringe_failure: Continuous victory music regardless of what happened.

comic_mechanisms.mechanism: The first reaction changes whether bystanders join a joke or withdraw.
comic_mechanisms.game_requirement: Track distinct reactions; one person can smile while another becomes uncomfortable.
comic_mechanisms.performance_proposal: A small glance between friends precedes group laughter. Avoid a canned audience track.
comic_mechanisms.cringe_failure: All spectators clap; a relationship score pretends there is one audience.

comic_mechanisms.mechanism: A procedural response meets a request that keeps changing.
comic_mechanisms.game_requirement: The officer recalls the earlier request accurately and has a reason to be distracted or patient.
comic_mechanisms.performance_proposal: Short concrete questions; no philosophical closing speech.
comic_mechanisms.cringe_failure: Every authority figure becomes either a sitcom fool or a moral lecturer.

audience_model.premise: Amusement, trust, embarrassment, attention and consent are separate responses.
dimensions: Does this viewer understand the setup?
Who becomes the butt of the joke?
Is the target participating or merely being filmed?
Does the viewer know consequences omitted by the edit?
Is the humour helping people endure pressure, or denying what someone nearby is experiencing?
audience_model.evidence_limit: One prior small platform-ranked thread and article-selected comments cannot establish a representative consensus.
audience_model.implementation: Record who witnessed the live moment, who saw which edit, and who received only its caption. Later reactions must use those exposures.

encounter_treatments.title: Just Say Revision
encounter_treatments.evidence_label: Unverified user lead; completely original adaptation
encounter_treatments.setup: Kabir is confidently explaining something to the camera when his mother calls. He asks you for help before admitting what help means.

beats.action: Phone vibration interrupts his sentence. He silences it, then it rings again.
beats.line: Kabir: Tu bas paas khada reh. Teacher jaisa.

beats.action: The officer asks who is blocking the passage; Kabir sees a solution and makes the request badly.
Mother is waiting; player can interrupt, hand back the phone or let the explanation continue.
beats.line: Kabir, quieter: Maths mat bolna. Maine maths chhod di.

choices.action: Offer your own improvised explanation
choices.ambiguity: Protects Kabir but makes you responsible for keeping the story consistent.
choices.delayed_payoff: A later call asks a detail established here.

choices.action: Ask the officer to speak, without promising what he will say
choices.ambiguity: Lets Kabir lose control of the story; officer may help, answer literally or decline.
choices.delayed_payoff: Officer recognises the player later but is not automatically compliant.

choices.action: Tell Kabir to answer honestly, then stay beside him
choices.ambiguity: Can be genuine support or feel like public abandonment depending on friendship and audience.
choices.delayed_payoff: Private response differs from the public clip.

choices.action: Keep filming the awkwardness
choices.ambiguity: May be welcomed as a shared joke or resented later; ask the subject before publishing.
choices.delayed_payoff: Kabir can ask for the clip to be removed when family sees it.

encounter_treatments.risk_design: Conversation usually adds familiarity; obstruction, persistence after a refusal or public humiliation can change reactions. No blanket legal claim.
encounter_treatments.reel_payoff: The phone vibration and Kabir’s sudden change of voice carry the joke; optional original music stops at the officer’s question.

physical_requirements.spatial_action: Kabir approaches the officer only if the player asks; the officer must be within conversational range before taking the phone.
interruptions: Mother repeats the question when nobody answers.
A genuine nearby duty can interrupt the officer without resolving the call.
state_commits: Remember the chosen subject/alibi and who actually heard it.
Recording and permission to share are separate actions.
physical_requirements.callback: A later call asks a detail the player supplied; do not reroll the remembered answer.

encounter_treatments.title: Same Group, Different Location
encounter_treatments.evidence_label: Original farce inspired by reported reversal
encounter_treatments.setup: Nikhil wants to stay with friends. Three messages each refer to a different gate as the main gate.

beats.action: Nikhil confidently identifies where everyone is.
A new message contradicts him while the officer is responding to the original request.
beats.line: Sharma: Tumhare dost hain ya delivery address?

beats.action: Player chooses whether to correct the request publicly or quietly confirm locations first.
beats.line: Kabir on phone: Hum toh chai pe hain. Tu kahan hai?

choices.action: Ask the officer to wait while you confirm
choices.ambiguity: Sensible but consumes patience and may miss the group.

choices.action: Commit to the first meeting point
choices.ambiguity: Decisive, but depends on the age and source of the message.

choices.action: Get everyone on one short call
choices.ambiguity: Fast if trusted; noisy and confusing if people talk over one another.

choices.action: Make the confusion into a running joke
choices.ambiguity: Relieves embarrassment for some; Nikhil may feel he is the joke.

encounter_treatments.delayed_payoff: Later reunion directions use the naming convention established here. A person you mocked may hesitate to admit being lost again.
encounter_treatments.risk_design: Costs primarily time and trust; official impatience depends on actual obstruction and other duties, not an arbitrary joke penalty.
encounter_treatments.reel_payoff: Cut between contradictory location messages and a single unimpressed reaction; keep the final phone answer unscored.

physical_requirements.spatial_action: Friends physically change location along visible paths; location messages retain send time.
interruptions: New message can arrive while the officer is responding.
state_commits: Set a chosen meeting point and attendees; arrivals resolve the reunion.
Do not teleport missing friends after a dialogue button.
physical_requirements.callback: A later lost friend uses the shared naming convention or remains reluctant after ridicule.

encounter_treatments.title: Is There a Cooling Department?
encounter_treatments.evidence_label: Original Delhi scene borrowing a reported Patna joke structure; not relocation of documentary footage
encounter_treatments.setup: Everyone is hot. Kabir asks about cooling arrangements with exaggerated practical seriousness. Sana is looking for cups.

beats.action: Kabir asks the question as if at a service desk.
beats.line: Kabir: Paani ka arrangement kis counter pe hai?

beats.action: The officer points to an ordinary water table; Kabir had expected a more dramatic response.
Sana hands over cups while still answering someone else.
beats.line: Sana: Joke baad mein bhi chalega. Cup abhi de sakta hai?

choices.action: Commit to the literal answer and become the enthusiastic water guide
choices.ambiguity: Can be funny and useful, or become attention-seeking if you monopolise the area.

choices.action: Try one more absurdly polite question
choices.ambiguity: Timing matters; the officer may enjoy it or be occupied with something serious.

choices.action: Quietly take the cups and help
choices.ambiguity: Low spectacle; later someone may remember despite no immediate applause.

choices.action: Ask Meera to film the failed punchline
choices.ambiguity: Self-deprecation can land better than trying to win the exchange.

encounter_treatments.delayed_payoff: A later crowd recognises you as the person who knows where water is, creating an obligation you did not expect.
encounter_treatments.risk_design: No in-game request guarantees safe police response. Do not direct actual use of crowd-control equipment.
encounter_treatments.reel_payoff: Tiny original fan hum, dry literal answer, then normal crowd sound; no explosive meme hit.

physical_requirements.spatial_action: The water task requires handling a cup/crate and reaching recipients. The spoken joke alone does not increase supplies.
interruptions: Sana can turn to someone needing attention; joke continues only if the player waits.
state_commits: Consume visible inventory on actual handover.
Record individual witnesses rather than rewarding the whole district.
physical_requirements.callback: People approach the player for water later because they witnessed the earlier help.

encounter_treatments.title: Who Has the Key?
encounter_treatments.evidence_label: Original fictional aftermath of a reported premise; no instructions for taking or using keys
encounter_treatments.setup: A missing key has become a popular joke before anyone knows whose key it is. The driver is losing time. Meera has only the final seconds on camera.

beats.action: Friends laugh at the clip; the driver asks a specific question nobody answers.
beats.line: Imran: Chabi kiski thi? Bas yeh bata do.

beats.action: Asha identifies a detail missing from the edit.
beats.line: Asha: Haan, par usse pehle bhi kuch hua tha.

beats.action: Player decides what to do with incomplete information while several audiences watch.
beats.line: Meera: Caption daal diya. Delete nahi kiya abhi.

choices.action: Help clarify the ownership and return the object through the visible handover
choices.ambiguity: Can resolve delay while embarrassing the person being celebrated.

choices.action: Share the funny short edit unchanged
choices.ambiguity: Peer recognition can increase while the driver and witnesses distrust your account.

choices.action: Ask both sides to appear in a follow-up
choices.ambiguity: Potentially clarifying; can also prolong unwanted attention.

choices.action: Stay out and ask the driver about an unrelated practical need
choices.ambiguity: Useful assistance without claiming knowledge, but avoids the disputed responsibility.

encounter_treatments.delayed_payoff: The public edit and the driver’s account circulate separately; later reactions depend on which version each person received.
encounter_treatments.risk_design: Consequential interference attracts attention independently of whether a bystander laughs. No claim about legal immunity.
encounter_treatments.reel_payoff: Two available edits from the same authored event; neither should fabricate an officer reaction.

physical_requirements.spatial_action: Object resolution is a supervised abstract handover animation, not a technical key-removal interaction.
interruptions: Driver can return to a call rather than remain a captive audience.
state_commits: Separate recovery of the object, the driver’s report and publishing an edit.
physical_requirements.callback: The people who received a short edit and those who witnessed the handover respond differently.

encounter_treatments.title: That Was Not the Question
encounter_treatments.setup: Meera starts a routine on-camera question, then gives an unexpectedly sincere compliment. Kabir is prepared for a roast and has no useful reaction.

beats.action: Meera asks whether the officer will answer a question.
Her compliment does not ask for a favour. Leave a short pause.
beats.line: Meera: Aap hase toh video ka mood hi badal gaya.

beats.action: The officer can acknowledge, ignore or set a filming boundary.

choices.action: Let the pause stand
choices.ambiguity: Requires confidence without escalating the bit.

choices.action: Ask the practical question you originally came to ask
choices.ambiguity: The compliment may now seem instrumental.

choices.action: Make yourself the target of the joke
choices.ambiguity: Can release pressure or steal someone else’s moment.

choices.action: Keep trying after a refusal
choices.ambiguity: Can become uncomfortable; the audience need not endorse it.

encounter_treatments.delayed_payoff: Recognition changes a later greeting, not permission to bypass every rule.
encounter_treatments.risk_design: Boundaries and situation matter; charm is not a universal protection mechanic.
encounter_treatments.reel_payoff: Use the unanticipated pause; do not add laughter that the characters did not produce.

physical_requirements.spatial_action: Officer and Meera exchange gaze, with enough space to leave; declining filming changes the available actions.
interruptions: Officer turns away for a duty; player can respect the interruption or persist.
state_commits: Familiarity changes only if the officer heard the exchange.
No automatic access permission follows a compliment.
physical_requirements.callback: Officer’s later greeting varies with whether the player respected a stated boundary.

encounter_treatments.title: The Part Before the Music
encounter_treatments.evidence_label: Original fictional editing encounter inspired by reporting on chase edits
encounter_treatments.setup: Meera has edited a chaotic dash into an impressive clip. The raw audio includes Kabir asking where everyone went.

beats.action: The triumphant edit plays for two seconds.
Nikhil accidentally plays the raw version.
beats.line: Recorded Kabir: Ruk, mujhe rasta nahi pata!

beats.action: Player chooses which account travels and whose permission matters.
beats.line: Meera: Raw mat chala. Raw mat—haan, ab sabne sun liya.

choices.action: Post the confident cut with context
choices.ambiguity: Balances image and explanation, but still centres your group.

choices.action: Share the raw version with friends only
choices.ambiguity: Intimacy and self-mockery, with a risk of forwarding.

choices.action: Ask everyone in frame before posting
choices.ambiguity: Slows the joke; might reveal someone did not enjoy the moment.

choices.action: Keep it private and turn it into an in-person joke
choices.ambiguity: No public recognition, but a shared memory can strengthen a relationship.

encounter_treatments.delayed_payoff: Different people recognise different versions later; a private clip can be forwarded by an actor with their own motives.
encounter_treatments.risk_design: Aftermath scene, not an instructional escape sequence.
encounter_treatments.reel_payoff: Original paired music/raw audio edits make the player hear how interpretation changes.

props: Two clips referencing the same recorded scene
physical_requirements.spatial_action: Friends gather around a phone in a safe pause; player can move the phone or step back.
interruptions: Raw clip starts before the player decides whether to stop it.
state_commits: Store raw performance and edit recipe separately.
Save audience and subject permission when distributing an edit.
physical_requirements.callback: The later recogniser quotes only the version they actually received.

sound_direction.status: original production proposal; no copied reel audio acquired or cleared
rules: Record separate close dialogue, off-camera friend reactions, local ambience and clean room tone.
Make pauses playable; do not fill every gap with music.
Use short original musical motifs and silence to distinguish raw experience from an edited reel.
Maintain spatial off-camera voices so a reaction feels located in the crowd.
Let actors overlap selectively; subtitles must still preserve the crucial line.
Test jokes with dry audio before adding a sound cue. If a cue is the entire joke, rewrite the scene.
Do not use stock laughter as proof that the room found something funny.
needed_evidence_before_matching_reel_sty: Audible source clips with lawful access
Clear distinction between original audio and repost-added soundtrack
Rights/provenance for anything proposed for reuse

acceptance_journeys.name: Two audiences

acceptance_journeys.name: Quiet option

acceptance_journeys.name: No impossible familiarity
